meta.description: PRDForge is a standalone, project-agnostic platform for PRD-driven AI code generation. Inspired by Ralph (VSCode Copilot extension), it provides a web dashboard to manage, visualize, and control autonomous PRD execution across multiple projects with pluggable AI backends (Claude, Codex, Gemini).
meta.tagline: Where PRDs are forged into code
meta.license: Internal tool first, potential open source later

phases.name: Core Engine Extraction
phases.description: Extract and generalize meta_prd_runner.sh into a standalone, project-agnostic execution engine

phases.name: Basic Web Dashboard
phases.description: Create minimal web UI for project management, run control, and basic visualization

phases.name: Multi-Project & Skills System
phases.description: Support multiple projects from central dashboard and implement inherit/override skills architecture

phases.name: AI Backend Plugins
phases.description: Add pluggable AI backends beyond Claude CLI (Codex, Gemini, direct API)

phases.name: Advanced Features
phases.description: Cost tracking, advanced visualizations, quality gates, team features foundation
